window: 16 Nov 18:00–17 Nov 12:00 Kyiv time (Ukraine Air Force preliminary); Russian MoD 16 Nov 20:00–17 Nov 08:00 Moscow time. Separate overnight assessments within the previous 24 hours, NOT one synchronized 24-hour theater total.
reporting_side: Ukraine Air Force via Ukrainian General Staff (official claims); Russian Defense Ministry via Reuters and Ukrainska Pravda (official claims); AP/Reuters independently report disruption, not independently verified interception counts
notes: PRELIMINARY AND ATTRIBUTED. Ukraine Air Force says 306 Russian drones launched (92 jet-powered); 211 aerial targets neutralized in total, including 205 drones; 44 impact locations; missile launch total unavailable. Russia MoD claims 1,441 Ukrainian drones intercepted in its separate 20:00–08:00 Moscow-time window, NOT independently verified and NOT a confirmed Ukrainian launch count. No verified aircraft losses. Reuters/AP corroborate significant Kerch Bridge disruption and damage, but precise strike details remain attributed; Russian-installed Crimea official reports two deaths, unverified independently. Kyiv North/South bridges closed for inspection following Russian strikes; some heating/water and electricity disruptions reported. Moscow airports reportedly temporarily restricted flights; no live flight status verified. Do not add totals across sides, or treat regional references as verified impact coordinates. Assessment timestamp is editorial update time, not official publication time.
